Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Avishka Fernando to open for the Lankans. Shoriful Islam to bowl first.
...THE CHASE....

For Sri Lanka, it was all about Wanindu Hasaranga! He was the star and the reason Bangladesh did not cross the 300-run mark. The rest bowled well in patches. They just couldn't find their lines and lengths and were very wayward. Their batters now face a stiff task. They do have the batting and of dew comes in, it should get easier for them. Bangladesh will hope that's not the case and they can defend it. Will the series be leveller?

After losing Das early, Sarkar and Shanto counter attacked. They batted brilliantly to steady the ship before Shanto fell. Sarkar and Hridoy then put up another handy stand and laid the platform. Sarkar though fell after getting to a half ton and then Bangladesh lost a couple quickly. Hridoy though held fort at one end. The tail supported him well and he has taken his side to a very competitive score.

Have to say this game is evenly poised at the halfway mark! Bangladesh will be pleased with the score they have got and Sri Lanka, on this wicket will feel have done well to keep the hosts below 300 which at one point they looked like they'll get to easily.

SIX! He does! Two in a row and the last two balls spoils the over! It turns into a brilliant one for Bangladesh! This is full and angled into the pads. Hridoy whips it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Bangladesh end with 286!

TOSS - Lanka have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

A 100 to remember from Shanto helped his side take a 1-0 lead in series. Another win and Bangladesh will have the series sealed. Sri Lanka on the other hand, have to win this game if they are to stay alive. Will we see them turn it around or will Bangladesh make it 2-0. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
... MATCH DAY ...

After the disappointing T20 series defeat, Bangladesh started the ODI series with a convincing win and finds themselves on the verge of sealing the series in style. Their bowlers were absolutely relentless in the first encounter, tearing through the Sri Lankan batting lineup with precision and aggression. The decision to include Tanzim Hasan Sakib ahead of Mustafizur Rahman paid off handsomely, as he wreaked havoc with three crucial wickets. Shoriful Islam and Taskin Ahmed complemented him brilliantly, sharing six wickets between them equally and showcasing their prowess in exploiting the home conditions. The spin duo of Mehidy Hasan and Taijul Islam was equally impressive, maintaining tight lines and adding pressure on the opposition. Bangladesh's batting lineup boasts players in top form, particularly Litton Das and Soumya Sarkar, with Das showcasing exceptional form in recent matches. They missed out in the first game and will look to contribute better in this one. Additionally, the leadership of Najmul Hossain Shanto, who delivered a match-winning century, alongside Mushfiqur Rahim's valuable half-century, has bolstered their batting strength. The inclusion of Mahmudullah and Towhid Hridoy further adds firepower to their lineup, while Mehidy provides depth and versatility down the order. With their bowlers setting the tone, Bangladesh will be buzzing with confidence and eager to replicate their performance in the upcoming game. However, Sri Lanka is not one to back down easily. Despite a lacklustre showing in the first match, they will be determined to bounce back and level the series. The openers got off to promising starts in the previous game but failed to capitalize, and Pathum Nissanka and Avishka Fernando will be itching to convert their starts into big scores this time around. Kusal Mendis and Janith Liyanage showcased their batting prowess with gritty half-centuries, but the onus will be on Charith Asalanka and Sadeera Samarawickrama to provide stability in the middle order and steer the innings towards a formidable total. In the bowling department, the trio of Dilshan Madushanka, Lahiru Kumara, and Pramod Madushan will look to provide early breakthroughs and peg back the Bangladeshi batting lineup. Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana, the dynamic spin duo, will be eager to unleash their magic and put the Bangladeshi batters under pressure. With both teams hungry for victory, the stage is set for an electrifying contest. Will the Bangla Tigers clinch the series with another dominant display? Or will the Lankans summon the spirit to stage a comeback and keep the series alive? The excitement is palpable as cricket fans eagerly await the thrilling showdown between these two formidable sides.
